content.text: This is an authorized isolated agent-lifecycle experiment. First spawn one child with task: Reply CHILD_ONE and use no tools. Wait for its completion. Send that same child a follow-up task: Reply CHILD_FOLLOWUP and use no tools; wait again. Then spawn two children concurrently, each asked only to reply CHILD_PARALLEL without tools. Wait for both. Do not use shell, files, network tools or MCP. Report their explicit IDs and finish.
